development_time: ~8 years (started ~2016–2017 → April 2025) [UNVERIFIED – prior knowledge; brief lead says ~7–8 years]
why_popular: Novel hybrid: a hand-crafted puzzle-mystery (Myst/Outer Wilds-style knowledge progression) wrapped in a roguelite room-drafting loop – every day you draft rooms from blueprints, so each run reshapes the house. Deep layered secrets and meta-puzzles reward note-taking and community sleuthing; striking painterly look; universal critical acclaim made it one of 2025's best-reviewed games; Game Pass day-one let millions try it risk-free.
marketing_channels: Raw Fury publisher PR + showcase appearances; Steam demo/festivals (no data on specifics); day-one Xbox Game Pass exposure; very strong critic reviews; puzzle/mystery streamers and YouTubers; Reddit/Discord community solving secrets; awards-season nominations (TGA 2025 Best Debut Indie).
engine: Unity [UNVERIFIED – prior knowledge; not confirmed this session]
art_style: Stylised 3D with a hand-painted, watercolour/architectural-illustration look; first-person; blue-tinged blueprint motif.
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: code the room-drafting system, inventory/state tracking, first-person controller, save system; generate textures, props and stylised room assets; draft notes/letters/lore text. AI cannot: design the interlocking multi-layer puzzle web (the core value), keep hundreds of clues consistent and fair, years of iteration/playtesting for 'aha' moments, a cohesive art direction, and the publisher/Game Pass deal. A smaller game with the same spirit (drafting a house of rooms + a few meta-puzzles) is feasible solo, but Blue Prince's depth is not. | Toolset: Claude Code + Unity 6 or Godot 4, Meshy/Tripo + Blender for room kits, Scenario/Midjourney for painterly textures and documents, ElevenLabs SFX/VO, Suno/Udio ambient music, a puzzle-dependency graph tool (e.g. spreadsheet or Articy/Yarn) to track clues.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 6–10 weeks, ~$300–$1,000 (Claude Max $100–$200/mo, 3D/image gen $30–$80/mo, audio ~$30/mo, Steam Direct $100) for ~20 rooms and one meta-puzzle. Excludes developer living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 12–18 months, ~$6,000–$25,000 (tools ~$300/mo, freelance art direction/3D polish $2k–$12k, music $1k–$5k, external puzzle playtesting + marketing $1k–$5k). Excludes developer living costs.
